steps.log: right sidebar collapse/expand animates the layout grid

steps.eval: (() => { const button = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label]')].find((item) => /打开右侧边栏|open right sidebar/i.test(item.getAttribute('aria-label'))); if (button === undefined) return 'MISSING OPEN'; button.click(); return 'clicked open'; })()

steps.check: layout frame is marked and has no permanent transition
steps.expr: (() => { const frame = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-chat-background-frame]'); if (frame === null) return false; return getComputedStyle(frame).transitionDuration === '0s'; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const frame = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-chat-background-frame]'); if (frame === null) return 'NO FRAME'; const before = frame.getAttribute('style'); frame.style.gridTemplateColumns = '280px minmax(400px, 1fr) minmax(0px, 500px)'; const duration = getComputedStyle(frame).transitionDuration; const animating = frame.hasAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background-frame-animating'); frame.setAttribute('style', before ?? ''); return JSON.stringify({ duration, animating }); })()

steps.check: dragging the sidebar edge is not delayed by a transition
steps.expr: (() => { const frame = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-chat-background-frame]'); if (frame === null) return false; return getComputedStyle(frame).transitionDuration === '0s' && !frame.hasAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background-frame-animating'); })()

steps.check: normal right sidebar paints the panel at the column size
steps.expr: (() => { const panel = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-chat-background-right-panel]'); const outlet = document.querySelector('[data-slot="rightbar"]'); const column = outlet === null ? null : outlet.parentElement; if (panel === null || column === null) return false; const panelRect = panel.getBoundingClientRect(); const columnRect = column.getBoundingClientRect(); const after = getComputedStyle(column, '::after').backgroundImage; return Math.abs(panelRect.width - columnRect.width) <= 2 && Math.abs(panelRect.height - columnRect.height) <= 2 && getComputedStyle(panel).backgroundImage === 'none' && after.includes('linear-gradient') && getComputedStyle(panel).backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' && getComputedStyle(column, '::after').display !== 'none'; })()

steps.eval: (async () => { const column = (slot) => { const outlet = document.querySelector('[data-slot="' + slot + '"]'); return outlet === null ? null : outlet.parentElement; }; const sample = () => ({ main: Math.round(column('main')?.getBoundingClientRect().width ?? -1), right: Math.round(column('rightbar')?.getBoundingClientRect().width ?? -1) }); const frames = [sample()]; const button = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label]')].find((item) => /收起右侧边栏|collapse right sidebar|close right sidebar/i.test(item.getAttribute('aria-label'))); if (button === undefined) return 'NO COLLAPSE'; const frame = column('main')?.parentElement ?? null; button.click(); if (frame !== null) window.__rightbarDuring = { animating: frame.hasAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background-frame-animating'), duration: getComputedStyle(frame).transitionDuration }; for (const delay of [30, 80, 140, 220, 380]) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delay)); frames.push(sample()); } window.__rightbarFrames = JSON.stringify(frames); return window.__rightbarFrames; })()

steps.check: collapsing the right sidebar moves through intermediate column widths
steps.expr: (() => { const frames = (() => { try { return JSON.parse(window.__rightbarFrames ?? 'null'); } catch { return null; } })(); const during = window.__rightbarDuring ?? null; return frames !== null && frames.length >= 5 && frames[0].right > 400 && frames[frames.length - 1].right === 0 && frames.slice(1, -1).some((frame) => frame.right > 10 && frame.right < 600) && during !== null && during.animating === true && String(during.duration).includes('0.3s'); })()

steps.check: collapsed right sidebar leaves no scrim rectangle behind
steps.expr: (() => { const panel = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-chat-background-right-panel]'); const outlet = document.querySelector('[data-slot="rightbar"]'); const column = outlet === null ? null : outlet.parentElement; if (panel === null || column === null) return false; return column.getBoundingClientRect().width === 0 && getComputedStyle(panel).backgroundImage === 'none' && !panel.hasAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background-right-panel-full'); })()

steps.log: fullscreen right sidebar paints one background + scrim layer

steps.eval: (() => { const button = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label]')].find((item) => /打开右侧边栏|open right sidebar/i.test(item.getAttribute('aria-label'))); if (button === undefined) return 'MISSING OPEN'; button.click(); return 'clicked open'; })()

(() => { const target = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label]')].find((button) => /^全屏$|^fullscreen$/i.test(button.getAttribute('aria-label'))); target?.click(); return target === undefined ? 'NO FULLSCREEN' : 'fullscreen'; })()

(() => { const root=document.documentElement; const main=document.querySelector('[data-slot="main"]')?.parentElement??null; const left=document.querySelector('[data-slot="sidebar"]')?.parentElement??null; const right=document.querySelector('[data-slot="rightbar"]')?.parentElement??null; return JSON.stringify({root:root.hasAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background-right-fullscreen'), main:main===null?null:getComputedStyle(main).visibility, left:left===null?null:getComputedStyle(left).visibility, scrim:getComputedStyle(root,'::before').backgroundImage.slice(0,120), rightAfter:right===null?null:getComputedStyle(right,'::after').display, htmlAttrs:[...root.attributes].map(a=>a.name).slice(0,20)}); })()

steps.check: fullscreen keeps the left sidebar and covers only the rest of the window

steps.eval: (() => { const exit = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label]')].find((button) => /退出全屏|exit fullscreen/i.test(button.getAttribute('aria-label'))); exit?.click(); return 'exit fullscreen'; })()

steps.check: fullscreen switches off in one unanimated step
exiting fullscreen restores the main layout and clears the marker
steps.expr: (() => { const root = document.documentElement; const main = document.querySelector('[data-slot="main"]')?.parentElement ?? null; const panel = document.querySelector('[data-dsh-chat-background-right-panel]'); return main !== null && getComputedStyle(main).visibility === 'visible' && !root.hasAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background-right-fullscreen') && (panel === null || !panel.hasAttribute('data-dsh-chat-background-right-panel-full')); })()

steps.eval: (() => { const collapse = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label]')].find((button) => button.getAttribute('aria-label') === '收起右侧边栏'); collapse?.click(); return 'collapse rightbar'; })()
